accessUnconfirmed: Access could not be confirmed. Verifying the workspace.
secureDownloadFailed: The document or its secure access could not be verified. Refresh its status and try again.
checkingRequest: Submitting or checking the request with Core API…
uncertain: The original request outcome is uncertain. Recover it without creating another document.
receiptUnavailable: The original receipt is unavailable. The original export may still exist. A new request may create another document.
statusUnverified: Export status could not be verified. Automatic tracking has stopped; the server job may still be running.
paused: Tracking paused. Refresh to continue observing the same export.
outdated: This export is outdated. Generate a new version.
freshnessUnknown: Freshness could not be verified. Verify again before downloading.
terminalFailure: The server could not generate this document. You can request a new export.
mayRetry: The original export may be retried by the server. Continue tracking it rather than creating another document.
currentDocument: Current document. Access will be verified again before download.
previousReady: Previous ready document (current status must be verified).
title: Export meeting minutes
description: Create official copies of the canonical meeting record. PDF and Markdown are generated by the server.
unavailable: Export is unavailable for the current meeting access.
admissionDisabled: New export generation is disabled in this deployment.
recoveryDisabled: Recovery is unavailable in this deployment.
secureNotConfigured: Secure downloads are not configured. Contact your administrator.
reviewRequired: Minutes require review before new official exports can be generated.
proposalsIncluded: Minutes contain unconfirmed AI proposals and are not eligible for export.
